1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1301|fe52f4ea.name: Julia Gallina
1301|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1327|a381f669.name: Reese Langston
1327|a381f669.text: Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!

1460|f8288f6c.name: Unger Statforth
1460|f8288f6c.text: Years of quality breeding techniques and plenty of care allow me the privilege of showing you these horses!  Please, take your time as you consider them for your mount.  A horse is a companion for the ages, friend.  Don't sell yourself short - get your steed here today!

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3181|a28d29e1.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

103-accept.name: Captain Grayson
103-accept.text:
The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.

Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
103-accept.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-complete.name: Captain Grayson
103-complete.text:
Praise you, brave $C.  The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work.  Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.

I died needlessly on this very shore.  My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
103-complete.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-accept.name: Captain Grayson
104-accept.text:
When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.

Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
104-accept.title: The Coastal Menace

104-complete.name: Captain Grayson
104-complete.text: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead.  Well done, $N.  By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved.  The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
104-complete.title: The Coastal Menace

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

116-complete.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-complete.text:
A job well done, $N!  I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor.  But my patrons will be happy once again! 

My wife is quite a seamstress.  Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
116-complete.title: Dry Times

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-complete.text:
By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? 

Oh I forgot to reward your service, $c.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
146-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

152-accept.name: Captain Grayson
152-accept.text:
You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.

Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
152-accept.title: The Coast Isn't Clear

152-progress.name: Captain Grayson
152-progress.text: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
152-progress.title: The Coast Isn't Clear

240-accept.name: Chef Grual
240-accept.text: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
240-accept.title: Return to Jitters

240-complete.name: Jitters
240-complete.text:
Aha!  Thank you, $N.  Those really hit the spot!

And here, please let me pay you for these!
240-complete.title: Return to Jitters

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

245-accept.name: Watcher Dodds
245-accept.text:
Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
245-accept.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

245-complete.name: Watcher Dodds
245-complete.text: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, $N, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
245-complete.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

276-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-accept.text:
The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the Wetlands peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.

They are no longer in balance with the land. For the Wetlands to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.

Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.
276-accept.title: Tramping Paws

279-accept.name: Karl Boran
279-accept.text:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
279-accept.title: Claws from the Deep

288-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-accept.text:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
288-accept.title: The Third Fleet

288-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-complete.text: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
288-complete.title: The Third Fleet

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-accept.text:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
289-accept.title: The Cursed Crew

305-accept.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
305-accept.text:
You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!

Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, $N. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
305-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

455-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
455-progress.text: You're coming from Loch Modan?  How is the orc situation at Algaz Gate?
455-progress.title: The Algaz Gauntlet

463-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
463-accept.text:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
463-accept.title: The Greenwarden

463-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
463-complete.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one.  Although I have many names, I answer to only a few.  But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.
463-complete.title: The Greenwarden

471-accept.name: James Halloran
471-accept.text:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
471-accept.title: Apprentice's Duties

484-complete.name: James Halloran
484-complete.text: Nice work you've done here, $N. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
484-complete.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

93-complete.name: Chef Grual
93-complete.text:
Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there!  Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
93-complete.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War
